recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-7996 source follow-up is needed; future comparator or search-qualifier behavior changes should be handled through newer, specific work-group decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-7996 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core search issue asking whether supported comparators, or a minimum expected comparator set, should be listed. The final resolution required adding comparator to SearchParameter, moving target/modifier/chain from CapabilityStatement to SearchParameter, and documenting that detailed support should be expressed through referenced SearchParameter resources.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit de92e40608f0e8b102ff69f3c478f8d531e708b4, '#7996 - move things from CapabilityStatement to SearchParameter', with svn r10356 matching the Jira application comment. That commit added SearchParameter.comparator, moved target/modifier/chain to SearchParameter, removed those child elements from CapabilityStatement searchParam, and updated CapabilityStatement.searchParam.definition guidance.
additional_context: The current SearchParameter resource is active in source/fhir.ini and still includes target, comparator, modifier, and chain. Current CapabilityStatement source directs modifier, comparator, target, and chained-parameter support details to SearchParameter resources. Current search.html lists comparator/prefix codes and semantics. Later related work such as FHIR-37622 and FHIR-25041 refines the same area and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current spec already satisfies the requested model and documentation direction, and extra FHIR-7996 prose would be redundant rather than a necessary conformance correction.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue added the SearchParameter.comparator type constraint and confirms comparator support remains governed by SearchParameter.
